business_summary: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells blowers, compressors, steam turbines, and boilers in China and internationally. The company offers industrial fans, centrifugal compressors, industrial boilers, and small steam turbines; and system integration products, such as air system reconstruction integration, pressure air station system integration, biomass gasification cogeneration system integration, and waste heat and gas cogeneration system integration.It also provides CNC vertical lathe, CNC heavy lathe, CNC lathe, CNC grinder, Five-axis machining center, Kehren grinder, Niles gear grinding machine, End Milling Machine, CNC plasma cutting, Boring and Milling machine, Automatic Welding robot, Five-axis machining center, CNC cylindrical grinder, Spinning machine, and CNC vertical lathe; three coordinate measuring machine, pit type overspeed test bench, spectral analyzer, mechanical tensile testing machine, steam turbine rotor thermal running testing machine, gear measuring instrument, overspeed test platform, high-speed dynamic balancing machine, compressor test platform, three coordinate measuring machine, electronic universal testing machine, and grating length measuring machine; and undertake processing. The company was formerly known as JiangSu Jin Tong Ling Fluid Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. in August 2019. Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Nantong, China.
